svg.text: Common remedies: know them by name

g.text: KNOW BY NAME (exam + ward!): NEEM (dogonyaro — fever baths, skin, "malaria" —
bitter, liver watch!) · MORINGA (food-medicine — leaves/pods, anaemia talk, gentle!) ·
PREKESE (aidan — soups, postpartum, BP claims!) · BITTER LEAF (onugbu — "sugar" remedy —
HYPO danger with diabetic drugs!) · GINGER (nausea, colds — bleed caution!) · GARLIC
(BP, "cleans blood" — bleed caution!) · ALOE (burns, skin — gut cramps if drunk!) · ASRAM
mixes (teething — ASK contents: some contain alcohol! lead! sedatives!).
PREPARATIONS: decoctions (BOILED — dose varies!) · infusions (steeped) · poultices (skin!)
· enemas (frequent — ask! dehydrate infants!) · baths (fever, skin, ritual!) · powders ·
alcohol-based bitters (pregnancy! children! liver! — flag!). Dose unknown = risk unknown.
BELIEFS AROUND THEM: "bitter cures" (stronger = better? — overdose logic!) · "natural =
safe" (deadliest myth — M03!) · purging cleans (diarrhoea = healing? — dehydrates!) ·
teething causes all (asram delays malaria care!) · "hospital + herbs clash always" (some do,
ASK ROUTINE: "which herbs…? how prepared…? how much, how often…? alcohol in it…? who
gave it…? since when…? any reaction…?" — warmly, no eyebrow! Document ALL (M05!).
RESPECT + VERIFY: honour the knowledge ("neem baths soothe — let's add ORS + watch fever!")
+ verify safety (pregnancy? bleeding? liver? — M03!) + follow up. Both, always both.
LINKS: NUT foods-as-meds · BEH Kleinman · M03 safety deepens.
MANTRA: "name it, dose it, ask alcohol, check pregnancy, follow it."
